{{Top|leg}}
The '''Merisee Grand Medical Facility''' was a collection of several buildings located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Caronath]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Merisee/Legends|Merisee]]. Dedicated to the healing arts, its services were expensive but fast and highly reliable. It was staffed by the finest [[Doctor/Legends|doctors]], [[Nurse/Legends|nurses]], specialists, [[Technician/Legends|technicians]], and [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] from the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]]. The Facility had the [[Merisee Asylum]] adjoining it.
